title: Dungeon Crawler Carl
author: Matt Dinniman
summary: Earth is turned into a televised death-game dungeon for an alien audience, and an ordinary man in very little clothing has to climb it level by level. His only companion is his ex-girlfriend's cat, who has opinions.
readIf: you want a fast, darkly funny survival romp that treats its game rules like a puzzle to be cracked.
skipIf: you dislike graphic violence, crude humour or stories where a game system sets the rules.

pairings.reason: Both turn a game-like system into the engine of the plot and reward readers who enjoy rules, loot and clever exploits.
Another comic take on Earth being treated as disposable by indifferent aliens, with a much gentler bite.
Shares the brutal, escalating competition and the sense of a cruel system watching you, but played completely straight.
